types.description: NH1 fuse link, 63 A, gG, front indicator, live grip lugs

document.title: Siemens Data sheet 3NA3122 (manufacturer document, distributor mirror)

modelingNotes: Voltage capability: 500 V AC / 440 V DC; no assigned nominal supply voltage. Rated current 63 A; datasheet current field specifies AC.
Terminal keys 1 and 2 preserve the manufacturer's circuit labels on physical page 4; they do not assert stamped blade markings, polarity or installation orientation.
Single fuse link only. Front indicator has no separate wired contacts. Live grip lugs are handling hardware, not PE or additional wiring terminals; base and indication accessories are excluded.
Normally closed contact metadata represents an intact fuse for drawing only. No fixed conductive link or protective trip simulation is asserted.

Width 30 mm. Hot power loss 6 W per pole at rated AC current. Sheet lists DC breaking capacity 25 kA and a separate 120 kA breaking-capacity entry; these remain documentation, not conductor current limits.

connectionCoverage.notes: Both blade interfaces of the standalone fuse link are covered using exact circuit labels 1 and 2. No separate indicator terminals, PE, shield or communication interfaces; handling lugs are not external wiring interfaces.
